title: Atomic Appliance Studies
description: Five independent advertisement-style studies of imagined 1950s-60s future kitchen appliances, each a standalone magazine ad rendering.
creative_direction: Independent product ad studies. Each image is a single-page color magazine ad for a different imaginary atomic-era appliance: rocket blender, auto-pantry, dishwasher dome, food-pill dispenser, and bubble-top coffee maker. No reference dependencies between images.
